```{r setup, include=FALSE}
setwd("xxx")

#Install packages "ggplot2" and "gggenes"
install.packages("ggplot2")
install.packages("gggenes")
library(ggplot2)
library(gggenes)

#Read Figure_1B_dat.csv file
tn_mutant_genes<-read.csv("Figure_1B_dat.csv")

#Define Target_gene as a factor
tn_mutant_genes$Target_gene <- factor(tn_mutant_genes$Target_gene,
                                      levels = c("ppiD", "tonB", "BLR19_RS09010", "purD", "pmbA", "others"))

#Color each gene
strain_col13 <- c(
  "ppiD" = "#e5ae23",
  "tonB" = "#802f89",
  "BLR19_RS09010" = "#8a7067ff",
  "purD" = "#ffbca7ff",
  "pmbA" = "#484f98ff",
  "others" = "#dceff4"
)

#Run ggplot for drawing gene arrow map
g<-ggplot(tn_mutant_genes, aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, y = molecule, fill = Target_gene,label = gene,forward = orientation)) +
  geom_gene_arrow(arrow_body_height = unit(8, "mm"),arrowhead_height  = unit(10, "mm"),arrowhead_width   = unit(10, "mm"),alpha = 1) +
  geom_gene_label(size = 20,fontface = "bold") +
  facet_wrap(~ molecule, scales = "free", ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set3")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = strain_col13) +
  scale_color_manual(values = strain_col13) +
  labs(y = "MF374 Genome",fill = "Identified gene") + 
  theme_genes()+
theme(
    # Axis text
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20, color = "black"),

    # Axis titles
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),

    # Facet titles
    strip.text = element_blank(),

    # Legend
    legend.title = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 20, color = "black",face = "italic"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(size = 1.2),
    axis.ticks = element_line(size = 1.5),
    axis.line.y  = element_blank(),   # ← remove genome baseline
    panel.border = element_blank(),   # ← required
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),

    # General cleanup
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

#Check the gene arrow map
g

#Save the gene arrow map as a tif file
ggsave("tn_mutant_genes_v1.tif", plot = g, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "tiff",compression = "lzw")

#Install a package "svglite"
install.packages("svglite")
library(svglite)

#Save the gene arrow map as a svg file
ggsave("tn_mutant_genes.svg", plot = g, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300, device = "svg")
```
